zh.title: Deutsche Aircraft 啟用 Leipzig D328eco 總裝線　規劃年產 48 架
zh.summary: 新廠占地 60,500 平方公尺，標誌 40 座 D328eco 渦槳支線機由研發階段轉向量產準備。
body: Deutsche Aircraft 於 2026 年 9 月 29 日在德國 Leipzig/Halle Airport 啟用 D328eco 最終總裝線。公司表示，新設施占地 60,500 平方公尺，規劃最高每年生產 48 架飛機。
D328eco 是一款 40 座渦槳支線機。總裝線啟用代表計畫從研發與工業化準備，進一步轉向序列生產所需的製造階段；這並不等同飛機已完成認證或開始交付。
薩克森邦政府表示，新廠預計創造約 250 個直接職位；Deutsche Aircraft 估計完整營運後可提供 250 至 350 個技術職缺。

en.title: Deutsche Aircraft opens D328eco final assembly line in Leipzig
en.summary: The 60,500-square-meter facility is designed for up to 48 aircraft a year as the 40-seat turboprop program prepares for serial production.
body: Deutsche Aircraft opened its D328eco final assembly line at Leipzig/Halle Airport on September 29, 2026. The company says the 60,500-square-meter facility is designed to produce as many as 48 aircraft annually.

The D328eco is a 40-seat regional turboprop. Opening the assembly line moves the program from development and industrial preparation toward the manufacturing phase needed for serial production; it does not mean the aircraft has already been certified or delivered.
The government of Saxony expects around 250 direct jobs, while Deutsche Aircraft estimates 250 to 350 skilled positions when the facility reaches full operation.

facts.claim: The D328eco final assembly line opened at Leipzig/Halle Airport on 2026-09-29.
The 60,500-square-meter facility is designed for up to 48 aircraft per year.
D328eco is a 40-seat turboprop and the facility is expected to provide 250 to 350 skilled jobs at full operation.
